title: Verify the actual exported theorem signature
obstacle: A convenient wrapper may hide extra premises or omit part of the requested conclusion.
procedure: Inspect the actual exported declaration, including implicit and structure-valued arguments.
Expand the proposition fields needed to compare it with the full target.
Derive necessary prerequisites from allowed inputs and assemble the intended theorem.
For an implementation claim, inspect fields for execution, output, charging and any model conversion. Establish the obligations the source does not give to the caller.
verification: Check the exported signature against every target hypothesis and conclusion, then inspect its trust dependencies.
positive_example: Derive an intermediate prerequisite inside the theorem from existing hypotheses.
negative_example: Expose that prerequisite as a new assumption of the exported theorem.

evidence.note: Editorially generalized guidance under this maintenance policy; no independent effectiveness result or proof acceptance is claimed.
General design guidance. Check its conditions in the current argument; no comparative performance claim.
